# Feature: Fog tile — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #53 (Fog tile) from Vision and Information before it is used in real levels. Effect: hides orbs until you stand adjacent. Unique: local hiding on one tile, even in a lit room. Useful: close-search spots without darkening a whole room. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** hides orbs until you stand adjacent.

**So that** close-search spots without darkening a whole room.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Fog tile for the first time in its teaching room (mech-53-fog-tile-room). Teaching moment: First room: a lit room with fog along one wall and the gate's last orb inside it. A player who walks the clear floor in the middle reaches the gate one orb short and must come back along the wall, which teaches that fog is searched by standing next to it rather than by looking at it. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: A fog tile never shows what is on it until you stand next to it, after which it stays revealed for the attempt
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Movement through fog is normal, so it hides in lit rooms where a dark room would be too much

## Edge Cases & Rules

- A fog tile never shows what is on it until you stand next to it, after which it stays revealed for the attempt
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Fog tile's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-53-fog-tile-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/vision-and-information.yml mechanic #53.
